description:
I’m Yuraj, an engineering admission and career counsellor who helps students navigate their options with clarity and confidence.
I guide students in choosing the right college and branch across Maharashtra, factoring in ranks, cutoffs, and future goals.
My support includes CAP round strategies, detailed cutoff analysis, and precise option filling.
I focus on honest, practical, and student-friendly advice to make the admission process simpler.
My goal is to help students take informed decisions and start their engineering journey on the right track.
